clipper-lib 6.4.2 (JavaScript port version 6.4.2.2), vendored without modification.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/clipper-lib@6.4.2/clipper.js
Upstream: https://github.com/junmer/clipper-lib

Used for polygon union, difference, contour inset and nested contour extraction.
This local copy is loaded before the app module and requires no network access.
